name: Ostarine

lead: Ostarine (enobosarm, MK-2866) is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator developed to treat muscle wasting. It reached phase III trials but was never approved.
Trials showed lean mass gains without matching functional gains. Recreational use is common and a frequent cause of anti-doping violations.

paras: It binds the androgen receptor, aiming for activity in muscle and bone with less effect on tissues such as the prostate. It suppresses natural testosterone production.
Not approved and banned in sport. Reported harms include hormonal suppression, lipid changes and drug-induced liver injury. Gray-market products are often mislabelled.
